goal: Recent sshd auth activity on dev-ws-1 around the incident window
what_to_summarize: accepted/failed sshd auth on dev-ws-1 in the window
whether the host is reporting auth events at all

params.query:
FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-25T09:35:00.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-25T09:45:00.000Z"
        AND host.name == "dev-ws-1"
        AND event.outcome IS NOT NULL
| STATS accepted = COUNT(*) WHERE event.outcome == "success",
        failed = COUNT(*) WHERE event.outcome == "failure",
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY source.ip, user.name
| SORT accepted DESC

goal: Any host activity at all from dev-ws-1 in the window (syslog/process/auth volume)
what_to_summarize: total event volume from dev-ws-1 by dataset in the window

params.query:
FROM logs-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-25T09:35:00.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-25T09:45:00.000Z"
        AND host.name == "dev-ws-1"
| STATS events = COUNT(*) BY data_stream.dataset
| SORT events DESC

goal: Baseline check on a peer host web-1 in the same window (is the whole environment quiet or just dev-ws-1)
what_to_summarize: sshd auth volume on web-1 in the window

params.query:
FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-25T09:35:00.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-25T09:45:00.000Z"
        AND host.name == "web-1"
        AND event.outcome IS NOT NULL
| STATS accepted = COUNT(*) WHERE event.outcome == "success",
        failed = COUNT(*) WHERE event.outcome == "failure"
        BY source.ip, user.name
| SORT accepted DESC
